catalyst_text: Received European Commission approval for this indication
detailed_catalyst_text: The European Commission approved paltusotine for adults with acromegaly, representing its first regulatory clearance in the EU. This provides an oral, once-daily treatment option and marks a first approval outside the U.S. Additional regulatory progress includes an NDA submitted in Japan by SKK and a Marketing Authorization Application submitted in Brazil.
catalyst_text_evidence: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRNX) today announced that the European Commission (EC) has approved PALSONIFY (paltusotine) ... for the treatment of adult patients with acromegaly. SKK recently submitted a new drug application (NDA) in Japan for paltusotine for the treatment of acromegaly. In Brazil, Crinetics recently submitted a Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) to Brazil's National Health Surveillance Agency (ANVISA) for PALSONIFY for the proposed treatment of acromegaly in adults. Crinetics is also in partnership with Sanwa Kagaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd (SKK) to develop and commercialize PALSONIFY for acromegaly in Japan, where the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare recently granted an orphan drug designation.

catalyst_text: Announced positive Phase 2 topline results in CAH
detailed_catalyst_text: An open-label Phase 2 cohort in classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia reported favorable topline results. Treatment produced a 67% mean reduction in morning androstenedione by week 12 and 88% of completers reduced glucocorticoids to physiologic replacement levels, with no serious or treatment-related severe adverse events and no hepatic transaminase events. An interim open-label extension snapshot showed similar biomarker improvements and dose reductions with continued clean hepatic safety.
catalyst_text_evidence: Crinetics also announced positive topline results from the fourth cohort of its Phase 2 congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) study of investigational atumelnant, a novel, once-daily oral adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) receptor antagonist candidate being developed for the treatment of classic CAH and ACTH-dependent Cushing's syndrome. Treatment with atumelnant resulted in rapid, sustained lowering of androstenedione (in all 8 patients that completed the fourth cohort). Seven out of these 8 patients continued to maintain lower A4 after glucocorticoid doses were reduced to physiologic levels. Atumelnant was observed to be well-tolerated, with no serious adverse events and no treatment-related severe adverse events. No participants discontinued due to adverse events. No patients experienced hepatic transaminase adverse events. A data snapshot with limited source data verification from the first 7 patients in the Open-Label Extension (OLE) to have completed 13 weeks shows both serum A4 reductions and GC dose reductions that are in line with those seen in Cohort 4. Additionally, investigators have not observed any serious adverse events or any treatment-related severe adverse events, and have not observed any hepatic transaminase adverse events to date with 25 patients enrolled and with 7 participants who have completed over 20 weeks of treatment in the study.

drug_indication: SST2-positive Neuroendocrine Tumors, SST2-expressing Solid Tumors
catalyst_text: Dosed first patient in Phase 1/2 study
detailed_catalyst_text: The company announced dosing of the first patient in its first-in-human Phase 1/2 BRAVESST2 trial of CRN09682 for SST2-positive neuroendocrine tumors and other SST2-expressing solid tumors. This marks clinical initiation for the program and advances the NDC platform into human studies, enabling safety, PK, and preliminary efficacy assessment.
catalyst_text_evidence: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRNX) today announced the first patient has been dosed in the Phase 1/2 study evaluating CRN09682 in patients with metastatic or locally advanced somatostatin receptor type 2 (SST2)-positive neuroendocrine tumors and other SST2-expressing solid tumors. “Dosing the first patient in the Phase 1/2 study marks a major milestone for CRN09682 and our NDC platform as a whole.”

detailed_catalyst_text: The first patient was randomized in a pivotal, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 study evaluating a once-daily oral therapy for adults with carcinoid syndrome due to well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors. The primary endpoint assesses change in flushing episodes, with bowel movements as a key secondary endpoint. This milestone marks formal initiation of the registrational program in carcinoid syndrome.
catalyst_text_evidence: SAN DIEGO, 2025-11-20 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Crinetics Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRNX) today announced the first patient has been randomized in the pivotal Phase 3 CAREFNDR trial, a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study evaluating the efficacy and safety of once-daily, oral paltusotine in adults with carcinoid syndrome due to well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors.

catalyst_text: Received IND clearance for oncology program
detailed_catalyst_text: An investigational anti-tumor candidate targeting SST2-expressing neuroendocrine and other solid tumors received Investigational New Drug clearance earlier in 2025. This regulatory acceptance enables initiation of first-in-human clinical studies. It advances development of a nonpeptide drug conjugate approach for NETs and other tumors.
catalyst_text_evidence: CRN09682, an investigational anti-tumor candidate targeting SST2-expressing neuroendocrine and other solid tumors, received Investigational New Drug clearance earlier this year.
